name: OECD Data API (SDMX)
provider: Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development
rate_limits: 60 data downloads an hour, and VPN traffic is refused (source: search summary of https://www.oecd.org/en/data/insights/data-explainers/2024/11/Api-best-practices-and-recommendations.html; the page itself returned HTTP 403 to us).
history_start: Varies by country and series; many monthly series start in the 1950s to 1990s.
what_it_has: Key economic indicators by country: short and long interest rates, inflation, leading indicators and GDP. It is the original source of the 3-month interbank rates we pull through FRED.
simple: A club of rich countries that collects the same economic numbers from each member so they can be compared side by side.
license_terms: Most OECD content since 1 July 2024 is under CC BY 4.0, so reuse is allowed with attribution, but third party material is excluded (source: search summary of https://www.oecd.org/en/about/terms-conditions.html, page blocked to us).
quality_notes: The API serves revised values only. Updates arrive with a lag; euro area and UK 3-month rates currently stop at 2026-01. We pulled the US 3-month rate to 2026-09 with no key (tested).

relevance.reason: Upstream source of our rate series, useful to fill gaps, but slow and revised.
